diagnosis: The active sessions endpoint scans all sessions in Redis and filters them by req.params.targetUserId without verifying whether the requesting client matches targetUserId or possesses organizational administrator rights. Any logged-in user can enumerate active sessions, IP addresses, user agents, and session IDs belonging to other users or high-privilege administrators.

GET /api/users/usr_executive_99182/active-sessions HTTP/1.1
Host: console.saas.internal:3033
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aregular_user_cookie
Accept: application/json
